# Three Links Tattoo

> Tattoo shop based in Bloomington, Indiana. Color traditional, black-and-gray, fine line lettering and the Totoro, Zelda and Pokémon pieces you've been doodling for years. Walk-ins every Friday. First tattoo? You're in kind hands.

## Services
- First tattoos: Nervous is normal. Reviewers say this is the place that made their first one easy.
- Color traditional: Bold lines and solid, saturated color that holds up for years.
- Pop-culture & anime: Studio Ghibli, Zelda, Pokémon, Dragon Ball and whatever fandom you carry around.
- Head & scalp pieces: Yes, heads. The shop loves tattooing them: flames, mandalas, dragons and more.
- Black & gray: Smooth shading, dotwork and realism, from mythology to mandalas to full sleeves.
- Florals: Peonies, roses, strawberry vines and butterflies in soft, bright color.

## About
Three Links Tattoo is a downtown Bloomington tattoo shop at 218 N Rogers St, a short walk from the Courthouse Square. You'll know it by the gold-leaf script on the front window. Inside: white paneled walls lined with framed flash, a red tool chest, a red chair and warm wood floors. The work covers a lot of ground. Bold color traditional mermaids, sacred hearts and boomboxes, peonies and strawberry vines, soft black-and-gray sleeves, dotwork mandalas, fine line scripture, finger tattoos, and a healthy amount of Totoro, Zelda and Dragon Ball. The shop tattoos heads, too, and loves it. Artists Ross, Mili and Aemilia have regulars who come back piece after piece. The doors are open seven days a week, walk-ins are welcome every Friday, and the shop runs the occasional flash day. Follow along on Instagram at @threelinkstattoo for new work and open spots. It's also a shop people trust with their first tattoo. Reviews come back to the same things: the artists are kind, they don't make you feel silly for being nervous, the room is relaxed and the music is good.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: I've never gotten a tattoo. Is this a good place for a first one?
  A: Yes. A lot of Three Links reviews are from first-timers who say the artists were patient, kind and didn't make them feel silly for being nervous. Bring your questions.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, every Friday. For a bigger or planned piece, call (812) 369-4677 or message @threelinkstattoo on Instagram to set up an appointment. The calendar can book up a month or more ahead, so reach out early.
- Q: What styles do you do?
  A: Color traditional, black-and-gray and dotwork, florals, head and scalp pieces, fine line and lettering, plus pop-culture and anime work like Studio Ghibli, Zelda, Pokémon and Dragon Ball.
- Q: Do you do piercings?
  A: No. Three Links is tattoos only.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Thursday 12 PM to 8 PM, Friday and Saturday 12 PM to 9 PM, Sunday 12 PM to 8 PM. Holiday hours can differ, so call ahead if you're not sure.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 218 N Rogers St, Bloomington, IN 47404. Downtown, a short walk west of the Courthouse Square. Look for the gold-leaf sign in the window.
- Q: Can I ask for a specific artist?
  A: Yes. Plenty of clients ask for Ross, Mili or Aemilia by name. Mention who you'd like when you call (812) 369-4677.
- Q: What should I bring?
  A: Your idea, plus any reference pictures or sketches that help explain it. Your artist will talk it through with you before anything starts.
